title: 第4章 希望有再见之日
content_zh:
身着一袭浅紫色类似中国古代女装的女子浅笑着回道“你别慌！放心，我不会害你，你能来到这里，也属我们有缘!”

见那女子虽是在笑，却掩饰不住眉宇间的幽怨，左晓瑶扯了扯嘴角勉强露出抹夸张的笑容道“我.....我不慌，我不知道自己怎么突然来了这里，也不知道该怎么离开，还请您给我个指示，多谢了！”

而那女子却绕着她转了一圈后，才回道“离开很简单，只要你想，就可与你进来时一样简单，只是你既以自己的血泪之情唤醒了我，怎么也该在我离去前陪陪我才是，就当作我把这紫尊三宝送给你的报答如何？”

“啊！三宝？.....您是说那发钗、镜子、篦子梳吗？可是它们突然消失了，既是您的东西，您应该知道它们去了哪吧？你尽管拿去就行，我....我拿着也没什么用，而且还找不到它们了。”

听这女子提到‘三’字，左晓瑶下意识的想起那突然消失，貌似跑到自己头里的那三样东西，虽有些不舍，毕竟那是奶奶临终前甚重交待自己要好好保管的‘嫁妆’，而那三样东西那么玄幻，竟能自己消失，与这女子能玄幻到从画里‘走’出来一样。

听她这么说，想想也是，只有玄幻的人才配那玄幻的东西，自己这么个平凡的小老百姓拿着也没什么用，说不定还会给自己带来坏处，再加上她目前的愿望就是赶紧离开这个诡异的地方，即便心痛不舍，可那三样东西也不知到底去了哪，还不如让这女子拿回去，只要自个能赶紧离开就行。

而那女子在微愣了一下，接着像是自嘲又像是嘲讽别人般的大笑过几声后，才笑容微敛的道“你可知那到底是什么东西？竟拒绝得如此干脆!”

“不知，奶奶临终前只说让我收好它们，将来作嫁妆！”听到那女子话中的凄凉，左晓瑶镇定下来，只是受这份情绪的感染，她不禁也有些伤感。

紫衣女子温和的笑着解释道“来，你也坐下，给我讲讲你过去的生活，为什么会有这么深的伤怀之情?”

原来是问自己的生平，看着这女子露出的令人感觉非常亲切的笑容，一直以来，从不喜将自己的生活与情感展现在别人面前的左晓瑶突生一股想要倾诉的冲动，和那女子一起坐到那张紫色竹床上后，竟不由自主的将自己从刚出生三天就被丢弃，后被孤伶一人的奶奶捡回，到处找人帮忙喂奶，含辛茹苦的将自己养大的过程，到奶奶前段时间去逝，自己悲痛难忍的思念一五一十的通通讲了出来。

讲完之后，才发现不知何时，自己竟已再次泪流满面，心中却因这次痛快的倾诉而舒服不少，见坐在她旁边的女子仍有些怔愣，甚至还有些疑惑。

下意识的先用衣袖胡乱将脸的泪水擦去，左晓瑶略有些不自在的道“我的生活这就是这样，很简单，只是我已习惯享受奶奶在时的快乐，现在就余下我一人，难免会觉得有些孤单，会很怀念有奶奶在一起的日子，只是人生嘛，就是这样，谁也不可能永远陪着谁，到了，还是得一个人过，刚开始虽有些不能适应，过着过着，也就习惯了，该怎么走的路，还得要继续走下去。”

看着左晓瑶那一脸生活本该如此的认真，并不是消极，而是对苦难生活真正的无畏，从沉思中反应过来的紫衣女子不禁喟叹道“是啊，你说得有理，到了，还是得一个人过，永远不能指望谁就该一定永远陪着谁，自己该走的路，还是得一个独自走下去。”

伤感的语气中透着释然，而两人间的气氛有些凝重，左晓瑶有些迟疑，不知自己该不该接话，而这女子在稍作沉吟后，迅速敛起先前先前的情绪笑问道“你刚才说，你从小就一边上学一边卖画贴，以补家用，上了十多年学后，到二十多岁不仅没有嫁人，还要出去做工挣钱，好像也没人说你这样不对，为什么这样呢？”

为什么会这样？不都是这样吗！哦，也不是，自己另类了点，是从小就得自力更生，可这也不是什么稀罕事啊。

见左晓瑶一脸不解，仿佛一切本该如此的答道“我家没钱，这样很正常啊，全国有很多穷人家的孩子都这样的。”

紫衣女略做沉吟整理了下语言后，才继续问道“我的意思是说，你家这么穷，你一个女儿家为什么还要去上学堂，学堂里为什么会收下你，你还上了那么多年，女子又不能考功名，到了二十多岁还没嫁人，你们凡人.....女子不是及?之后就该嫁人吗？你怎么还出去做工挣钱，好像也没人说你的样子。”

学堂？及?？这次倒轮到左晓瑶有些不解了，只是当她的目光落到紫衣女子的这身装束上时，脸上突然闪过一抹了然，随后便简单的现代世界中的现状为这女子讲解了一番，世括现代世界如何形成。

而在听说这个世界里的女子可与男子争权夺势，婚姻自由，离婚是常事，可载人在空中飞行的飞机，在水中潜行的潜艇，日行数千里不足为怪后，只见那女子已是满面震惊之色。

“凡人.....凡人界竟能.....”从这女子的轻喃声中可听出，她震惊的显然不是空中飞、水里行的神奇，惊的是这一切的神奇竟由凡人在实现。

左晓瑶虽也注意到她对自己这类人的称呼，却并不感到奇怪，若这女子也以正常人自称，反倒令她更难以接受些，从画中‘走’出，已注定她的身份绝对不普通，甚至属神话中的传说人物。

那女子显然并非常人，心境非同一般，迅速从最初的震惊中反应过来后，她又陆续问出许多与现代世界有关的问题，而早褪去最初的那份不自在的左晓瑶也是知无不言，一一回答，甚至还讲出许多现代习以为常的事作为解释，尽量满足这女子的好奇与疑惑。

因多年来养成的处事习惯，心中虽很明白两人间的身份不同，但因除了想从女子这得到那个如何离开的‘简单’方法外，左晓瑶对她并无它求，心中坦荡，所以她自能谈笑自如的与这女子相处，而她这无意中的言行举止，倒令那女子目中闪过一抹透着欣慰之意的欣赏。

眼看那女子本看似与常人无异的身体突然变得有些虚幻，像是可能随时消散的样子，左晓瑶不禁有些担心“您....您怎么？”

“你不用担心，我既说过要将紫尊三宝送给你，自然会告诉你进出这里的方法，可惜，我留在这里的只是一缕神识，时间一到，必须收回，否则，我还真想去你生活的这个世界走走，因为你，我明白了许多事，也总算能放下一些执念，所以，我很感谢你，希望我们将来能有再见之日，到时，你要再给我......”

随着一道泛着紫芒的青光突然没入她的眉心，左晓瑶顿时再次陷入晕厥之中！

再次醒来，左晓瑶发现自己已再次躺在自家客厅中的沙发上，回想起自己在那个莫名空间中所遇到的一切，她已分不清那些是真是假，只是随着脑海中突然传出一阵巨痛，待她如看书般读过那些内容后，才明白那一切果然是真。

即便这段经历真的有够玄幻，而她自己却可能从此也将成为玄幻中人！

content_en:
The woman wearing a light purple dress similar to ancient Chinese women's clothing smiled and replied, "Don't panic! Don't worry, I won't harm you. You are here because we are destined!"

Seeing that the woman was smiling, she couldn't hide the resentment between her brows. Zuo Xiaoyao twitched the corners of her lips and forced an exaggerated smile and said, "I...I'm not panicking. I don't know why I came here suddenly, and I don't know how to leave. Please give me some instructions. Thank you very much!"

But the woman circled around her before replying, "Leaving is easy. As long as you want, it can be as easy as when you came in. It's just that you woke me up with your blood and tears, so you should accompany me before I leave. How about treating it as repayment for me giving you these three purple treasures?"

"Ah! Three treasures?... You mean the hairpin, mirror, and comb? But they suddenly disappeared. Since they are your things, you should know where they went, right? You can just take them, I... It's useless for me to hold them, and I can't find them."

Hearing the woman mention the word "three", Zuo Xiaoyao subconsciously thought of the three things that suddenly disappeared and seemed to run into her head. Although she was a little reluctant to part with them, after all, they were the "dowry" that her grandmother had told her to take good care of before she died. And those three things were so mysterious that they could disappear on their own, just like the woman could "walk" out of the painting.

Listening to what she said, and thinking about it, only fantasy people are worthy of those fantasy things. It is useless for an ordinary commoner like me to hold it, and it may bring harm to herself. In addition, her current wish is to leave this weird place quickly. Even if she is heartbroken, she doesn't know where those three things have gone. It is better to let this woman take them back, as long as she can leave quickly.

The woman was stunned for a moment, then laughed a few times as if she was mocking herself or others, and then she said with a faint smile, "Do you know what on earth that is? You rejected it so simply!"

"I don't know. Before she died, grandma only told me to keep them and use them as dowry in the future!" Zuo Xiaoyao calmed down after hearing the desolation in the woman's words. However, affected by this emotion, she couldn't help but feel a little sad.

The woman in purple smiled gently and explained, "Come, sit down and tell me about your past life. Why are you so sad?"

It turned out that he was asking about his own life. Seeing the woman's very friendly smile, Zuo Xiaoyao, who had never liked to show her life and emotions in front of others, suddenly felt the urge to talk. She sat down with the woman on the purple bamboo bed., he involuntarily abandoned himself three days after he was born, and was later picked up by his lonely grandma. He looked for people everywhere to help feed him, and went through all kinds of hardships to raise him. When his grandma passed away some time ago, he told all about his unbearable grief and longing.

After she finished speaking, she realized that at some point, she had burst into tears again. However, she felt much better because of this heartfelt confession. She saw that the woman sitting next to her was still a little stunned and even a little confused.

Subconsciously wiping away the tears on her face with her sleeves, Zuo Xiaoyao said slightly uncomfortably, "This is my life. It's very simple. It's just that I'm used to enjoying the happiness of grandma's presence. Now that I'm the only one left, it's inevitable that I'll feel a little lonely and nostalgic."I miss the days when I am with my grandma. It is just life. No one can stay with anyone forever. When the time comes, you still have to live alone. Although it was a bit difficult to adapt to at first, as you live it, you will get used to it. You have to continue to walk the way you want."

Looking at Zuo Xiaoyao's face that life should be so serious, it is not negativity, but a true fearlessness in the suffering life. The woman in purple who reacted from her deep thoughts couldn't help but sigh, "Yes, you are right. Now that we are here, we still have to live alone. We can never rely on anyone to always accompany someone. The road we should take, we still have to walk alone."

There was relief in the sad tone, but the atmosphere between the two was a bit solemn. Zuo Xiaoyao was hesitant, not knowing whether she should answer the call. After a moment of pondering, the woman quickly regained her previous emotions and asked with a smile, "You just said that you sold drawings and stickers while going to school since you were a child to make up for the family. After studying for more than ten years, you not only did not marry when you were in your twenties, but also went out to work to make money. No one seemed to say that this was wrong of you. Why is this?"

Why is this happening?Isn’t that the case all the time!Oh, no, I am a bit different. I have had to be self-reliant since I was a child, but this is not a rare thing.

Seeing Zuo Xiaoyao's puzzled expression, she replied as if everything should be as it should be, "My family has no money. This is normal. There are many children from poor families across the country who are like this."

The woman in purple pondered for a moment to sort out her words before continuing to ask, "What I mean is, your family is so poor. Why do you, a daughter of a family, still go to school? Why does the school accept you? You have been going to school for so many years. Women can't take the exams for merit. You are still unmarried in your twenties. Shouldn't women get married later? Why do you still go out to work to make money? No one seems to care about you."

School?and??This time it was Zuo Xiaoyao's turn to be a little confused, but when her eyes fell on the purple-clothed woman's outfit, a flash of understanding suddenly flashed across her face, and then she briefly explained the current situation in the modern world to the woman, and how the modern world was formed.

And after hearing that women in this world can compete with men for power, that marriage is free, divorce is common, that it is not surprising that planes can fly in the air and submarines can travel thousands of miles a day, the woman's face was full of shock.

"Mortals...how can the mortal world..." It could be heard from the woman's soft murmur that she was obviously not shocked by the magic of flying in the air and walking in the water. What was shocking was that all these magics were actually realized by mortals.

Although Zuo Xiaoyao also noticed the name she used for people like her, he was not surprised. If this woman also called herself a normal person, it would be more difficult for her to accept. When she 'walked' out of the painting, her identity was destined to be absolutely extraordinary, and even a legendary figure in mythology.

The woman was obviously not an ordinary person, and her mood was extraordinary. After she quickly recovered from the initial shock, she asked many questions related to the modern world. Zuo Xiaoyao, who had long since lost her initial discomfort, also knew everything and answered them one by one. She even explained many things that are commonplace in modern times as explanations, trying to satisfy the woman's curiosity and doubts.

Due to the handling habits she had developed over the years, she knew very well that their identities were different, but apart from wanting to get a 'simple' way to leave from the woman, Zuo Xiaoyao had no other desires from her and was open-minded. Therefore, she was able to talk and laugh with the woman freely, and her unintentional words and deeds made the woman's eyes flash with appreciation.

Seeing that the woman's seemingly normal body suddenly became a little unreal, as if it might disappear at any time, Zuo Xiaoyao couldn't help but worry, "What...what are you doing?"

"Don't worry. Since I said I would give you the Three Purple Treasures, I will naturally tell you how to get in and out of here. Unfortunately, what I left here is only a ray of spiritual consciousness. When the time comes, I must take it back. Otherwise, I really want to go to the world you live in. Because of you, I understand many things and can finally let go of some obsessions. So, I am very grateful to you and hope that we can see each other again in the future. When the time comes, you have to give me again..."

As a gleaming purple light suddenly disappeared between her eyebrows, Zuo Xiaoyao suddenly fell into fainting again!

When she woke up again, Zuo Xiaoyao found herself lying on the sofa in her living room again. Recalling everything she encountered in that inexplicable space, she could no longer tell whether it was true or false. She just felt a sudden pain in her mind. After she read the content like a book, she realized that it was all true.

Even if this experience is really fantasy, she herself may become a fantasy person from now on!
